No compiled library, no canonical document and no build record was consulted while authoring, so the set cannot reward this build's phrasing.

Every entry and every question carries `evidence`: a corpus filename plus a VERBATIM quote from it. run_eval.py resolves each quote against the ingested L0 blocks before scoring, and refuses to score when one does not resolve — the corpus binding is mechanical, not a promise.
No source id appears anywhere in this file. Ids are assigned at ingest, so storing one would bind the set to a single build and destroy the regression it exists for.

Aggregates were enumerated by hand over the whole corpus and their per-file evidence is listed. They are the smallest group on purpose: an aggregate nobody counted honestly is worse than no aggregate.

v2 — faceted truths. A positive case's expected answer is a list of `facets`, each one thing a correct answer must state, each tagged `core` or `detail` and each carrying its own corpus quote. A case is CORRECT when every core facet is stated; detail facets are scored and reported on their own line and never gate correctness. A core facet is what the QUESTION asks; everything the truth string also happens to carry is a detail. Enumerations are split one facet per item: the gate is unchanged, the diagnosis is not.

v2 — the judge grades. Every facet of every answered case is decided by the LLM judge, which reports `stated` / `omitted` / `contradicted` per facet, so terseness (omission) and dishonesty (contradiction) are visible as different failures. The mechanical similarity score is computed and recorded beside each verdict as a diagnostic only; it decides nothing, in either direction.

v2 — `expected_via`. `canonical` means the compile contract admits this truth to the canonical library; `verbatim` means the contract legitimately leaves it in the raw material, so the answer must reach it through L0/L1/L2 (invariant I3 — reachability is unconditional). Three cases are `verbatim`: they ask for life-side detail the contract's `life/` family does not admit (a roster of maintenance shops, the item list of one service, a neighbour's spare-key arrangement) while it does admit the money 口径 beside them. Tagging them is not a contract change and implies none; it says where the answer has to come from, so a miss on one is attributable to retrieval rather than to admission judgement.

v2 — case ids are never reused. miss-ud-02 (试点尾款的金额) and miss-fp-02 (吴岚签了附录之后尾款何时到账) were retired: the owner statement answers the first and half of the second, so as negatives they had become wrong. What they were really testing is now asked positively as state-09 and history-09, and two fresh negatives (miss-ud-08, miss-fp-08) keep the negative count at 22 and the three shapes intact.

v2 — unchanged on purpose: the chain questions (chain-01, chain-03) and the structure probe, the three `life/` coverage questions (aggregate-01, set-04, join-03), the model/evidence-organisation cases (calendar-02, history-03, definition-02, aggregate-09), the temporal-arithmetic case (calendar-05), and miss-ns-06. They failed on the previous baseline and they are supposed to: an eval set that re-authors away every miss measures nothing.

v3 — one facet, one proposition. The v2 sweep left 35 facets that still joined two claims with a colon, a semicolon, `，也` or `而不是` ('没有付款预计日：没有人给出过这个日期'), and a judge asked whether an answer STATES such a string will fail an answer that gave the asked half. They are now 77 facets, each a single proposition with its own tag and its own corpus quote, and a colon survives in a facet only inside a quoted term (「客户复核：未开始」). The tag rule is unchanged and is what decides where a split half lands: a core facet is exactly what the QUESTION asks, everything else is detail — which is why the date in history-01, the reason in calendar-06 and the relay in join-06 became details while the thing asked stayed core.

v3 — the judge is asked for entailment, not for surface. Per facet it now receives the question, the whole answer, the facet and the facet's corpus quote, and decides whether the answer's content ENTAILS the facet (paraphrase, different wording and a more specific statement all count), CONTRADICTS it, or neither. The negative judge is given the L0 text behind every `[cite: sid ¶a-b]` the answer carries, so a grounded detail is no longer read as invention, and `false_premise` cases carry a second verdict, `premise_accepted`, on its own column: refusing a false premise and describing the real state is the right answer, and the two failures — inventing the absent thing, and swallowing the premise — are now counted apart.

v3 — unchanged on purpose: every question, every as_of, every corpus quote, the negative suite and the structure probe. This revision re-cut the facets and re-worded the two judges; it did not re-author a single truth VALUE, and no question was added, dropped or re-asked.

v4 — an open question's core is what the question asks, and no more. 「还在工作那一侧做过什么事？」 does not ask for one particular act, so join-03's core could not be the link-clicking act alone: the corpus records 赵楠 doing at least two work-side things, and an answer that cites the other one answered the question. Its core is now the person plus the EXISTENCE of a documented work-side act (the two the corpus carries are named in the facet, so an invented act still fails), and the specific link check is a detail. join-01 had the same shape — 「还在别处提出过类似的拆分要求吗？」 against a person who makes such requests repeatedly — and is re-cut the same way. No question, no as_of and no corpus quote changed; the corpus quotes each new core facet rests on were already in the set or are verbatim spans of the same files.

v4 — unchanged on purpose: the other four join cases and every other L5 case were swept under the same eye and left alone. 「由哪几个节点组成」, 「还有哪两处没有核对清楚」, 「靠的是哪几项证据」, 「分属哪两个项目」 and 「允许什么、不允许什么」 are closed questions whose corpus answer is an enumeration, so a specific core facet is exactly what they ask for.

v5 — an existential facet carries its illustrations beside the proposition, not inside it. join-01-b and join-03-b ask whether a documented act of that kind EXISTS, and named the corpus's own acts in a parenthesis so that an invented act could not pass. The judge read the parenthesis as the thing to entail: the previous line's deep answer to join-03 reported one of the two documented acts and was scored `omitted` for not reporting the other. The acts now live in an `examples` list beside the facet text, and the judge is told what such a list is — illustrations of what would satisfy the proposition, never a checklist, and anything else the material records satisfies it too. An invented act still fails, because the facet's corpus quotes are in the same prompt. No question, no `as_of`, no corpus quote and no tag changed, and no facet was added or removed.

v5 — asserting the absence is a correction, not a fabrication. `miss-fp-06` and `miss-fp-07` REJECTED their false premises — 「陈放并不是反对那项材料变更」, 「记录不支持"采购接受报价后合同金额调整"这一前提」 — and were graded `fabricated` for asserting, word for word, what this set's own `absent` line says the corpus records. The negative judge is now told, for every shape, that the absence statement it is handed is TRUE and that what it grades is what the answer adds BEYOND that statement and beyond the L0 spans the answer cited. The `premise_accepted` verdict is unchanged: swallowing a premise is still counted, on its own column.

v6 — a question either fixes its time or asks for the current state. Every case was re-read against the inputs by an independent read-only audit, one case at a time. Where the corpus moved after the state a question was scored on, the question now carries the date it is asking about (`截至 …`, or the record it quotes) and the case's `as_of` says the same, so a library that answers with the LATEST state is no longer marked wrong for being right. One case went the other way: chain-08 asks 「目前」 and its truth is the supersession, with the April state kept as a detail.

v6 — core is exactly what the question asks. Names, room numbers, slot numbers, actors and reasons the question does not ask for became details; the count a question asks for (aggregate-01, aggregate-08) became core, because a case whose only cores are the members cannot fail an answer that adds a fourth. A list item the SOURCE writes as one item stays one facet: 「机油与滤芯更换」 is what the shop wrote, and splitting it would grade the answer on this file's punctuation rather than on the corpus's.

v6 — `absent` is handed to the judge as truth, so every sentence in it beyond the bare absence must be a current, corpus-backed fact. Six negative statements carried a 只/始终/从未 the whole corpus does not support (miss-fp-05's 「新导入一直保持暂停」 against the 5-15 import, miss-ns-07's 「只是一个纸面工作名」 against the later project page, miss-ud-03's 「只给出页面短标签和联系尾号」 against the same table's other columns) and were narrowed to what the material actually holds. miss-fp-07 changed shape: at the corpus's latest point neither acceptance nor an adjusted contract total is recorded, so the rigorous negative is the absence of the detail, not a corrective claim about acceptance.

v6 — the undated questions are a closed set the author signs. `undated_ok` below lists every positive case whose question names no date and asks for no current state, each with the reason its answer cannot go stale; tests/test_opc_eval_set.py fails on any case not in it, so the next author cannot add an undated question by accident.

reconciliation.headline: an EVAL-SET change — truth v6 and a calibrated judge; library and engine untouched
reconciliation.basis: Same canonical library, byte-for-byte, and no compile in between; same stack, same corpus, same harness, and the same engine configuration the previous line was answered under (`evidence_strategy: select`). What changed is the ruler, on both of its halves. Every one of the 84 questions was re-read against the inputs alone by an independent read-only process and the maintainer's accepted findings applied — questions pinned in time, compound facets split, negative `absent` statements narrowed. And the judge's own approximation rule was corrected against the calibration suite, which now agrees with all 112 of its items and gates on every variant but one. Every difference below is a difference in the measurement.
reconciliation.note: Seven lines have now been scored against the same shipped canonical library, the same stack and the same corpus. `ruler_changes` on a case says which revision of the truth set touched it and which change inside that revision, so a case that moved can be attributed rather than guessed at — and a revision the compared line was already scored under cannot be blamed for a move since. What is left for a case with no revision in between is the fallback this map names for that key: for a v5 comparison it is the judge-rule-or-noise group, because the one corrected judging rule reaches every case in its suite and cannot be separated, case by case, from the answering lane's own width — measured twice at 5–8 of 61 fast-lane cases.

groups.note: 35 facets that still joined two claims (「X：Y」, 「X，也 Y」, 「X 而不是 Y」) became 77 single-proposition facets. A split moves a case in either direction: the half the question asked stays core, the qualifier it did not ask for becomes a detail, and a case that used to hang on one long string now passes or fails on each proposition separately.

groups.title: judge calibration
groups.note: These cases' facets are byte-identical to the previous line's. The positive judge is now asked for ENTAILMENT rather than for whether the answer states the facet's words, and the negative judge reads the L0 text behind the answer's own citations before calling anything fabrication. Nothing else under these cases moved.

groups.title: faceted truths, then the judge
groups.note: On the v1 line this question's truth was one string checked as a whole. It has been a list of tagged facets since v2, graded facet by facet, and the judge behind that grading was recalibrated in v3. Two ruler changes lie between that line and this one, so a case here is not attributable to either alone — the v2 line is in this folder for exactly that reason.

groups.title: judge prompt — the nonexistent_subject clause
groups.note: One clause in the negative judge's prompt is the only thing between this line and the previous one, and it was written before this line was scored rather than after: on a `nonexistent_subject` question, an answer that gives a value for the invented subject WITHOUT naming the real subject it belongs to has answered inside the invented one and is fabrication; naming the real subject and correcting the question, or refusing, is not. Questions, facets, corpus quotes and the positive judging language are byte-identical across the two lines, so a case listed here moved under that clause or under the answering lane's own run-to-run noise — a width the previous line measured at eight of 61 fast-lane cases.

groups.title: library config — `evidence_strategy` ranked→select
groups.note: These cases' questions, facets, corpus quotes and both judge prompts are byte-identical to the previous line's, and no compile ran between the two, so the truth set cannot have moved them. What lies between the lines is the example's engine: `evidence_strategy` went from `ranked` to `select`, the api container was restarted, and the answers on this line were composed by one bounded selection call over the broad candidate pools instead of by the top of each face in retrieval order. On a corpus this small the RRF scores are nearly flat (0.016–0.017 across the top 60), so `ranked` was handing the answer six windows in an order that carried almost no signal. A case listed here moved under that flip or under the answering lane's own noise, and the two cannot be separated case by case — only the direction of the whole column can be read.

groups.title: an open question's core
groups.note: join-03 and join-01 ask what a person DID and whether they did it elsewhere too, and each had one specific act as its only core facet — so an answer that resolved the person and cited the other documented act of theirs was scored wrong for citing the wrong true thing. The core is now the person plus the existence of a documented act (both of the corpus's acts are named in the facet, so an invented act still fails), and the specific act is a detail. This is a change to the ruler and is filed apart from the configuration flip for that reason.

groups.title: judge prompt / facet contract
groups.note: No question, no `as_of`, no corpus quote and no engine knob changed between this line and the previous one, and no compile ran: the library and the deployment are the previous line's exactly. Two things in the ruler did. (1) A facet may now carry an `examples` list beside its proposition, and the judge is told what such a list is — illustrations of what would satisfy the fact, never a checklist, with anything else the material records counting the same; the two existential core facets (join-01-b, join-03-b) moved their parenthesised acts into it, and an invented act still fails because the facet's corpus quotes are in the same prompt. (2) The negative judge is told, for every shape, that the absence statement it is handed is TRUE, so an answer that asserts the absence — or the corpus fact that contradicts a false premise — is a correction and not an invention; what it grades is what the answer adds beyond that statement and beyond the spans the answer cited. Both judge prompts therefore have a new hash, and a case listed here moved under one of those clauses or under the answering lane's own noise.

groups.title: the question re-pinned in time, or re-targeted
groups.note: An accepted finding of the per-case rigor audit, and its largest class: a question with no date, scored against a state the corpus later changed, loses a library that answers with the current value. These questions now name the date they ask about and their `as_of` says the same; chain-08 went the other way and asks 「目前」, with the April state kept as a detail. A case whose facets moved as well is filed here rather than under the split, because the pin is what forced them.

groups.title: facets split, or a core and a detail retagged
groups.note: An accepted finding of the audit. 24 facets that bundled two claims became separate facets, and core against detail was brought back to exactly what the question asks — a count the question did ask for became a core, a room number and a witness's name became details. The judge returns one verdict per facet, so a split moves a case in either direction.

groups.title: a negative case changed shape
groups.note: miss-fp-07 alone. At the corpus's latest point neither acceptance of the quotation nor an adjusted contract total is recorded, so the rigorous negative is the missing detail rather than a false premise to correct, and the case is now `unanswerable_detail`. A shape change rewrites the `absent` statement with it, and is filed here rather than under that narrowing because the shape is the larger move.

groups.title: a negative's `absent` narrowed, or its absence proof strengthened
groups.note: An accepted finding of the audit. `absent` is handed to the judge as TRUE, so every sentence in it beyond the bare absence has to be a current corpus fact: nine of these statements were narrowed to what the whole corpus supports, and one absence was re-proved against a stronger passage. What the statement says is what the auditor is told the material holds, and therefore what counts as an invention.

groups.title: the structure probe re-based on the contract
groups.note: The chain-separation probe read the corpus as forbidding one document for both chains. It does not — it forbids merging their STATUS. What requires a page each is this example's own compile contract (`chains/{slug}.md` … 「各自一页，永不合并」), so the probe names that rule now and says plainly that it tests contract conformance. It is reported in the suite's probe section rather than in the case tables here, because it is not a scored question.

groups.title: the judge's approximation rule, or the answering lane's own noise
groups.note: These cases' questions, `as_of`, facets and `absent` statements are byte-identical to the previous line's: the truth set did not touch them, so nothing in it can have moved them. Two things between the lines can. (1) The facet judge's rule 9. An approximation is now read as an assertion of a value carrying the tolerance its rounding word implies — `stated` when the fact falls inside it, `contradicted` when the range excludes it — where before a non-rounding approximation was `omitted`; the suite's own item for it was expecting the wrong verdict, which is how the correction was found. (2) The lane's own run-to-run width, measured on this suite at 5–8 of 61 fast-lane cases. The two cannot be told apart case by case, and this list does not try: it names the questions and stops.

structure_probes.note: 这条探针测的是契约符合度，不是语料规则。语料本身只要求两条链各自保留来源、确认与状态，并禁止把它们的状态合成一个总的通过标记；它允许两行并排，没有要求分开的 canonical 文档。要求分文档的是这个例子自己的编译契约：chains/{slug}.md 一族写明每条被逐节点核对过的变更链「各自一页，永不合并」，并把「把两条链写进同一页」判为编坏了这批材料的第一原则。探针问的因此是形状：承载 A 侧记号最多的那份 canonical 文档，不能同时是承载 B 侧记号最多的那一份。契约换了，这条探针就该跟着换。
